attention1.ptxt: If you do not select a suitable route and take proper precautions when performing a road test, an accident can occur.

item.ptxt: Select a level road with no traffic to minimize the risk of accident.
Perform the road test with 2 persons, a driver and a tester.

attention4.ptxt: Failure to take the following precautions when checking the ATF may cause failure of the A/T.

item.ptxt: Do not use any fluid other than the specified ATF. Use of any other fluids may cause juddering or other faulty conditions.
Avoid overfilling the A/T. If the A/T is filled with excessive fluid, the fluid can foam and flow out through the breather.
The resulting loss of fluid may cause slippage and failure of the transaxle.
Use only lint-free paper for wiping. Do not use cloth or rags.
Limit the driving speed permissible in road conditions and regulations.
Perform ATF level check before checking any service on A/T.
Do not add or drain ATF before each test.

s1.ptxt: Hoist vehicle and remove engine undercover.
With select lever in P range, remove ATF over flow plug (1) and drain ATF.
If ATF does not come out, remove ATF filler plug (2) and add specified ATF until ATF comes out from over flow plug hole.
Install ATF over flow plug (1) and tighten it to specified torque.
Remove filler plug (1) and pour ATF approx. 0.5 liter (1.06 / 0.88 US/Imp. pt.).
Install ATF filler plug with new O-ring and tighten it to specified torque.
With ignition “OFF”, connect SUZUKI scan tool to DLC (1).
Start engine and display “Data List” mode on SUZUKI scan tool.
Drive vehicle so that “ATF temperature” reaches 65 °C (149 °F).
While keeping engine idling, depress brake pedal fully. Move shift select lever from P to D, maintaining for 2 seconds or longer in each position. Repeat this process twice.
Check that ATF comes out. If ATF does not come out, go to Step 5).
Install ATF over flow plug (1) with new O-ring (2) and tighten ATF over flow plug to specified torque.
Set ignition “OFF”, and disconnect SUZUKI scan tool from DLC.
